scope.selection: 23 previously reviewed exact licence records rebound and rechecked against installed Refresh131 workbook, plus 27 additional records selected from current institution/facility site clusters (9 each Changi T1, NUS Deck/Yusof Ishak, SIT Campus Court).
rules: Do not infer tenant closure from absence in an institutional directory; record roster absence separately.
Do not treat site-level public access as proof an exact outlet is currently operating.
Distinguish conditional visitor-pass access from unrestricted walk-in access.
Scope temporary restrictions to the facility and dates named by the issuing institution.
Do not propagate Jurong Port pass rules to 29A Jurong Port Road Food Centre without evidence the centre is within the restricted perimeter.

ite.scope: ITE College West training dining outlets; page updated 8 Oct 2026, names Amber West, Chez West and Crema West; reservations, hours, contact and October-November menus shown. Supports current existence for exact matching license/name only; no blanket campus-entry rule.

ntu.scope: Official NTU alumni story describes visitors and relatives returning to campus and dining at Canteen 1 or 2. Site-level public visitor dining evidence; not exact tenant roster.

nus_pass.scope: Official NUS visitor-pass terms state an individual visitor pass grants dining access at specified NUS canteens/food courts, with identity/purpose checks and access denial possible. Conditional visitor access; not unrestricted walk-in proof.

nus_campus.scope: Official visitor page lists temporary access restrictions for UTown food courts during specific dates in Aug-Oct 2026, including Fine Food and Flavours. Restrictions are time/facility scoped and do not match The Deck/Yusof Ishak addresses reviewed.

sit.scope: Current official page states Campus Boulevard level 2 and below, including food courts, are public-accessible. Lists current Foodgle Hub hours and public holiday access.

sit_stalls.scope: Current official Foodgle Hub page lists current stall names and operating hours. Exact matching names support presence; similar/category names are marked not exact.

airport.scope: Official Changi Airport Group article dated 12 Apr 2023 explicitly places T1 Staff Canteen at Basement 1, Public Area. This is older site-level access evidence, supplemented by the 22 Jul 2026 official T1 public-area food-court article; neither identifies each exact tenant or proves current tenant operation.

jtc.scope: Current JTC F&B listing includes public food-stall tenancy at Jurong Port Food Centre, 29A Jurong Port Road. Does not prove whether entry crosses a restricted port boundary; unresolved.

jp_pass.scope: Official Jurong Port FAQ states port entry needs sponsored JP Pass and identity verification. Boundary between public JTC food centre and secured port is not established, so cannot apply this restriction to these records.

sfa.scope: Current SFA food establishment registry/candidate export is the exact licence/name/address reference for each selected row. SFA listing proves licence identity/status in the source snapshot, not active daily operation or public entry.

airport_current.scope: Current official article published 22 Jul 2026 identifies Orchis Food Court in Terminal 1 public area and notes it serves airport staff with public and staff prices. Supports current public-area T1 food-court access; it does not explicitly identify all workbook T1 canteen licensees, so tenant linkage remains site-level.

summary.reason: Primary-source review supports public-area/visitor access for selected university, SIT and airport facilities, but several cases involve conditional visitor passes or site-level evidence only. No strong current exact-branch permanent closure or definite public-entry prohibition was found among these 50; unresolved cases remain flagged rather than removed.

limitations: This is a targeted sample of likely institution/canteen/closure-risk records, not a nationwide exhaustive closure search.
The SFA licence snapshot is an identity/status source, not proof of current daily trading.
For NUS records, visitor-pass terms indicate conditional rather than unrestricted access.
For some records, operator site source is facility-level and does not name the exact stall; no exact operation claim is made.
No network API, Mapbox request, paid service, or workbook edit was made.
